title: 2 a.m. buzzing and knocks in Florida home

tellings.quote: years later then I'm in I'm at home. I'm in Florida now. And uh 2:00 in the morning, something like that.

plain: Years after earlier strange events, the author Peter Levenda says he was at home in Florida at about two in the morning when he heard buzzing and knocking in the house. Levenda tells it as something that happened to him, and he brings it up alongside the writer Whitley Strieber, who is known for his own accounts of night-time visitors.
